AuthorizationRequest.title: AuthorizationRequest
AuthorizationRequest.description: Typed authorization request: principal id, opaque action kind, and the tenancy-scoped resource, over opaque ids only.

AuthorizationRecordVersion.title: AuthorizationRecordVersion
AuthorizationRecordVersion.description: Version discriminator carried by every serialized authorization record (currently 1).

PrincipalId.title: PrincipalId
PrincipalId.description: Opaque principal id: "principal:" followed by a lowercase slug (mirrors @epoch/identity).

ResourceReference.title: ResourceReference
ResourceReference.description: The tenancy-scoped resource a request acts on: opaque type and id plus the optional tenant/workspace/project scope (a resource without a tenant is platform-scoped).

TenantId.title: TenantId
TenantId.description: Opaque tenant id: "tenant:" followed by a lowercase slug (mirrors @epoch/tenancy).

WorkspaceId.title: WorkspaceId
WorkspaceId.description: Opaque workspace id: "workspace:" followed by a lowercase slug (mirrors @epoch/tenancy).

ProjectId.title: ProjectId
ProjectId.description: Opaque project id: "project:" followed by a lowercase slug (mirrors @epoch/tenancy).
